$Comment: Student: reach Friendly with the Mastery Trainer (the reputation Mmo_Mastery_Trainer), the first of
seven achievements in this folder that pay mastery points as a player rises with the trainer.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's standing has reached, each time it changes and when
they log in, so a player who jumps several ranks at once finds each rank's achievement waiting.
Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id; the criterion's TextKey words the step with
the rank's name. The pay sits in Rewards.Claim, so it waits in the Mastery section of the achievement
book until the player collects it. Listing.Chains lists the seven together as one ladder,
To change what a rank pays, ship a file of the same name in a later pack and edit Rewards. Keep the
ids: a player's progress is filed under them.
